card.name: Start of words split after O or PRO
card.fires_on: A short capital O, o, PRO or BO piece that begins or sits inside a longer word, such as Oceans, Oceana, Ophthalmologic, omeprazole, PROactive or COMBOGESIC. The rest of the word follows right after.

modes.label: O at start of word
modes.description: A lone O or o opens a longer word like oceans, ophthalmologic or omeprazole.

modes.label: PRO in PROactive
modes.description: PRO opens the trial name PROactive after 'In' or 'both'.
modes.example: during the three year<< PRO>>active clinical trial, 14 patients

modes.label: Inside brand or odd names
modes.description: A split piece appears inside a capitalized brand name or a name with an apostrophe-like mark.
modes.example: discontinue COM<<BO>>GESIC IV and evaluate the patient immediately
